activity_summary: Hamnet Sadler, who was owed nothing, had seen you cross the street three times. He said it was a kind morning's walk. You said you were buying bread. He said eight loaves' worth. You did not correct him.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Called it bread, and did not mend the joke.

entities.name: Hamnet Sadler
entities.context: Named the walk, and priced it as eight loaves.

facets.activity: Let eight loaves stand for the morning

quotes.speaker: hamnet_sadler
quotes.text: That's a kind morning's walk, Will.
